history.2026-07-08: Created for TASK-001 (Plan Lock 1/3). Replaces the old admin_session presence-only cookie check with real Supabase Auth + role checks, and formalizes the Role/Permission Registry required by TASK-001's Definition of Done.
history.2026-07-14: Added workspace_landing (Enterprise Workspace Architecture, Phase 1) — role-to-destination is now data here, not code in app/login/page.tsx's old ROLE_HOME. /business intentionally has no entry: no role lands there today (see the Phase-1 architecture proposal's orphaned-workspace finding) and this phase does not invent one.
history.2026-09-23: Added capability_access + capability_access_note (SLICE-1 of the locked Full System Upgrade Line, owner decision D1=A): the NEW Business Workspace (/workspace) now derives which business tools a role may see from this registry through core/navigation/resolveCapabilityAccess.ts instead of showing every tool to every authenticated user. Presentation filter only — no role moved, no route_access/api_access entry changed, and every server route keeps its own requireAuth() guard.
history.2026-11-22: Removed the platform-wide user role and global admin tier from current source permissions. Historical migrations, commits and evidence remain unchanged. Business user listing, global profile-role mutation and full backup routes are disabled; scope-aware APIs require verified owner/admin membership and exact company IDs. Database migration 20261122000011 disables legacy global history/subscription readers but remains unapplied pending an authorized database connection.
